decisions.reason: As the flagship cloud email service prominently featured on the home page and central to the firm's direction, it is highly unlikely to be removed.
It has its own product page and a documented customer success, indicating it is an established, valuable offering.
Email-to-fax conversion supports multichannel messaging and is mentioned on the website, making it a supporting service likely retained.
Although a feature close to the core fax offering, it remains a necessary optimization and is still listed, so retention is likely.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses security needs and builds on the established communication services, making it important to keep.
